claims: Northern Ireland is a country within the United Kingdom.
Northern Ireland is located on the island of Ireland.
Northern Ireland comprises six counties.
Belfast is the capital of Northern Ireland.
Northern Ireland was established in 1921.
Northern Ireland was created in 1921 as a separate entity from six northeastern counties.
The six northeastern counties had a Protestant unionist majority.
Northern Ireland's creation followed the partition of Ireland.
The Troubles occurred c. 1968–1998.
The Troubles were three decades of conflict between republican (mostly Catholic) paramilitaries and loyalist (mostly Protestant) paramilitaries.
The Troubles resulted in over 3,500 deaths.
The Good Friday Agreement was in 1998.
The Good Friday Agreement largely ended the conflict.
The Good Friday Agreement established a devolved power-sharing government.
The Good Friday Agreement established the Northern Ireland Assembly.
Northern Ireland is located in the northeast of Ireland.
Northern Ireland features the Mourne Mountains.
Northern Ireland features the Giant’s Causeway.
The counties of Northern Ireland are Antrim, Armagh, Down, Fermanagh, Londonderry (Derry), and Tyrone.
Belfast is the largest city in Northern Ireland.
Derry has intact city walls.
The currency of Northern Ireland is the pound sterling.
English is the main language in Northern Ireland.
Irish is recognized as a minority language in Northern Ireland.
Ulster Scots is recognized as a minority language in Northern Ireland.
